# Capgemini Technology Services India Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-30 · status **complete** · Budget spent: 4 documents fetched, 5 web searches, entity thoroughly confirmed and three fiscal years of statutory CSR figures captured with a rich planned-budget project list; further partner-by-partner and district-level detail exists in the source but was capped for time.

Capgemini Technology Services India Limited (CTSIL), CIN U85110PN1993PLC145950, incorporated 1993, registered Pune, is the main Section-135-bound CSR entity for Capgemini's India operations (formerly iGATE Global Solutions Limited). Confirmed via MCA-derived CIN on ZaubaCorp and CTSIL's own Secretarial Audit Report. Statutory CSR annexures (Annexure V of the Board's Report) were read for FY2024-25, FY2023-24 and FY2022-23, giving prescribed CSR, amount spent, admin overheads, impact assessment cost and excess-spend for each year. A separate CSR Annual Action Plan FY2024-25 (board sub-committee document dated 26 July 2024) gave a detailed, though PLANNED/BUDGETED (not confirmed actual), project-by-project breakdown across five themes (Digital Academy, Digital Literacy, Tech4Positive Futures, Sustainability, Thought Leadership) naming implementing partners, locations and rupee amounts. FY2024-25 and FY2023-24 Annexure V also carried impact-assessment executive summaries for a dozen-plus named projects (e.g. AADHAAR Digital Academy, DIYA/Anudip Foundation, School of Coding, Mission Million Trees/ENBITECH, Organ Ease/IIT Madras, YuWaah/UNICEF+CIFF+Amazon+UNFPA+UNHCR+Rohini Nilekani Philanthropies Foundation) with quantified outcomes. PAN, CSR-1 registration number and Darpan ID were not found in the sources read; no published CSR/grants contact mailbox, no open RFP/'partner with us' page, and no named grants (as opposed to implementing partners) were found. Capital assets via CSR were explicitly 'No' every year. The statutory Annexure V does not include a project-wise spend table for FY2024-25/FY2023-24 (only impact-assessment narratives); project-level rupee amounts came from the separate, non-statutory CSR Annual Action Plan, which is a planned budget rather than confirmed actual spend - flagged in notes on each such record.

Website: https://www.capgemini.com/in-en/about-us/csr

## What it set out to find

- identity: legal name, funder_type, section 135 status, website, parent
- identifiers: CIN, PAN, CSR-1
- csr_year FY2024-25/FY2023-24/FY2022-23: obligation, spend, overheads, impact assessment cost, excess
- csr_spend: project/aggregate amounts by sector, state, implementing agency
- footprints: states/districts where programs actually ran
- partners: named implementing NGOs/agencies by year
- programs: themes and named projects
- metrics: reported outputs/outcomes from impact assessments
- contacts: published CSR mailbox
- documents: annual reports, CSR annexures, CSR plan
- rfps/open calls for partners
